final_image_verdict: No official image was accepted for the Carbon Black 1TB variant. Every image found on the confirmed official product page was either (a) textually confirmed to depict a Robot White SKU, (b) confirmed by its own caption to illustrate an unrelated sustainability feature, or (c) fetched, byte-verified, and visually inspected, showing a white-cased console. The page's own per-variant image-gallery mechanism has dedicated slide sets for both Robot White SKUs (512GB and 1TB) but no corresponding set for Carbon Black at all -- a structural absence, not merely an unsuccessful search. This is stated as a confirmed gap in the available official content, not a claim that no such photo exists anywhere on xbox.com.

Explicit spec line "XBOX Series S Carbon Black: 1TB Custom NVME SSD", listed separately from the two Robot White lines (512GB and 1TB) in the same TECH SPECS block -- confirmed live, uncommented.
